title: The 52-Week High and Momentum Investing
one_line: Nearness to the 52-week high predicts stock returns better than past returns and does not reverse long-term; later work links it to profitability/investment (q-factor), and practitioners find it sensitive to holding-period choices.

findings.statement: Price / 52-week high dominates past returns in forecasting.
Later: q-factor model largely captures it in value-weighted samples.

why.pattern: Anchoring on the 52-week high (slow reaction near highs).

reported_results.headline: Nearness to the 52-week high predicts stock returns better than past returns and does not reverse long-term; later work links it to profitability/investment (q-factor), and practitioners find it sensitive to holding-period choices.

tradable_edge: Stock-level; an index version (ES near its 52-week high) is untested here.
data_fit: Single-stock study — not testable on our ES/NQ data.
caveats: Read by Claude in a chat session (manual run 3), not by the weekly pipeline.
